title: Cartwise+ Annual Upgrade Charge for Monthly Members
content:
The upgrade charge of a Cartwise+ Membership member on a monthly plan who moves up to Cartwise+ Annual is Cartwise+ Annual's period fee of 99.00 less the upgrade credit, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

## The upgrade credit

The upgrade credit is the fee captured for the current monthly period multiplied by the calendar days from today up to the day before the renewal date, divided by the days in the period, rounded to the cent.

| Term | Meaning | Record |
|---|---|---|
| Fee captured for the current period | every fee charge whose billing period start is the current period's first day, totalled | the membership's fee charge entries |
| Days ahead | the calendar days from today up to the day before the renewal date, both included | the renewal date on the membership record |
| Days in the period | the calendar days from the period's first day up to the day before the renewal date | the current period's start and renewal date |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A monthly period from 12 April to 12 May (30 days) with a fee of 9.99 captured for it; today is 20 April.

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Days ahead | 20 April up to 11 May | 22 |
| Upgrade credit | 9.99 multiplied by 22, divided by 30, rounded to the cent | 7.33 |
| Upgrade charge | 99.00 less 7.33 | 91.67 |

## Further cases (hypothetical)

- **Two charges for the same period.** Where the membership shows a charge of 4.49 and another of 4.49, both with the current period's first day as billing period start, the fee captured for the period is 8.98.
- **Upgrading on the period's first day.** All days of the period are ahead, so the credit is the whole fee captured for the period.
- **Credit above the annual fee.** The charge is zero, never negative.
